title: DOG-GS: Direct Orthophoto Generation from Georeferenced 3D Gaussian Splatting
description: DOG-GS renders a true orthophoto and a median-depth DSM directly from a georeferenced 3D Gaussian Splatting model (e.g. the UTM export of GeoSplat v0.2.0) using an orthographic Gaussian rasterization operator with front-to-back alpha compositing, and provides validation tools (DSM vs GNSS, horizontal checkpoints, relative comparison with a reference orthophoto).
